stories.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
stories.text: Marina named her dot Aria to help her get from research to a proposal in a few hours instead of several days. Aria looked through about 300 website sitemaps to help figure out which sites to include in a new offer. More than 1 million businesses around the world are achieving meaningful results with OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: Review how proposal generation tools can speed up client deliverables and reduce manual research time.

stories.title: Supercharging AI Agents: Build a Git-Based Engineering Knowledge Framework in 20 Minutes
stories.text: Authors created an AI-powered engineering knowledge system called the Second Brain to preserve architectural decisions and source evidence. The Kubernetes upgrade agent uses knowledge captured in the Second Brain to automate approximately 80% of the upgrade process. Subsequent ingestions into the framework can take around 3 minutes.
stories.why_it_matters: Adopt similar knowledge frameworks in client orgs to improve architectural documentation and automate routine upgrade tasks.

draft.question: How would you advise a client on implementing an engineering knowledge framework like the Second Brain for their AI agents?

items.text: [AI RADAR] How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth

- Marina named her dot Aria to help her get from research to a proposal in a few hours instead of several days.
- Aria looked through about 300 website sitemaps to help figure out which sites to include in a new offer.
- More than 1 million businesses around the world are achieving meaningful results with OpenAI.
**Client Impact:** Review how proposal generation tools can speed up client deliverables and reduce manual research time.
[AGENTFORCE] Supercharging AI Agents: Build a Git-Based Engineering Knowledge Framework in 20 Minutes

- Authors created an AI-powered engineering knowledge system called the Second Brain to preserve architectural decisions and source evidence.
- The Kubernetes upgrade agent uses knowledge captured in the Second Brain to automate approximately 80% of the upgrade process.
- Subsequent ingestions into the framework can take around 3 minutes.
**Client Impact:** Adopt similar knowledge frameworks in client orgs to improve architectural documentation and automate routine upgrade tasks.
